How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UPPSC Deputy Secretary Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of UPPSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UPPSC Deputy Secretary (IT) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the UPPSC Deputy Secretary (IT) recruitment is 14 October 2026. Ensure all submissions are completed by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Deputy Secretary (IT) post is 35 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years as of 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Deputy Secretary (IT) position?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.E/M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology with 12 years of experience, or a ‘C' level course from D.O.E, or B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology with 14 years of experience, or M.C.A./M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information Technology with 14 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Secretary (IT) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Deputy Secretary (IT) post in this recruitment drive by UPPSC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 105/-. This fee needs to be paid online during the application process.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. There are five years for SC/ST/OBC (UP domiciled), State Govt Employees, and Teachers. Ex-Army personnel get 3 years plus their service period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Deputy Secretary (IT) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 15600 - 39100 Per Month, corresponding to Level-12 with a Grade-pay of Rs. 7600/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Deputy Secretary (IT) post involves a Screening Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for the UPPSC Deputy Secretary (IT) recruitment must be submitted online only through the official UPPSC website.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
